head_commit.message:
T-3088: Reuse prepared Navigator code for occupied drivers

Prepare the registered Inspector module alongside eligible driver-card metadata.
Reuse that module when a visitor inspects a driver, avoiding a second cold import
boundary. Preparation creates no panel or seen marker and preserves current UI
ownership. Keep import deduplication, later-choice ownership and failed-load retry.

Integrate DEV42 while retaining occupied transport, standing idles and prior
loading/card fixes. Actual transport, driven-assembly, Navigator and native
report checks pass; publication checks qualify the exact staged tree. Keep the
previous phone-card timeout and native tail timeout as negative evidence.

Full native preflight, new-source scene interaction and current-HEAD CI remain
required before DEV merge. No broader photographic or gait completion is claimed.

Checkpoint: owner-requested incremental feature branch; full preflight pending
